description: This source file provides functions for reading from and writing to CSV files, including functions to generate CSV lines from a file and to write CSV data to a file.

methods.name: GenerateCSVLines
methods.description: Reads a CSV file line by line and applies a handler function to each line, skipping the first line.

methods.name: WriteCSVToFile
methods.description: Creates a CSV file with specified header columns and multiple rows of data.
